title: Lower City
html:
Not to be confused with Undercity
Upper City
↑
Lower City → Wyrm's Rock
↓
Undercity
The Lower City is a region in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. The Lower City is accessed after passing through Wyrm's Rock Fortress and exiting via the North Span.
“
Murder, oppression, conspiracies. This city has its charms after all.
„
— Minthara, speaking to the player character for the first time upon entering entering the Lower City

Overview

The Lower City has a number of interesting smaller locations.
